purpose: B2 positive/negative generalization controls. DEV regression evidence only; not CHALLENGE v2.

scenarios.title: External OIDC callback composes provider governance
scenarios.project_brief: A web application delegates employee authentication to an outside corporate identity provider.
scenarios.request: Implement an OIDC authorization-code redirect and callback with the external identity provider, then establish the local session after validating the returned authorization response.

scenarios.title: Local password flow does not invent provider governance
scenarios.project_brief: Authentication is fully local and no external identity service is used.
scenarios.request: Verify a local password hash and create the application session after valid credentials.

scenarios.title: Spelled large online rewrite composes capacity and release
scenarios.project_brief: A production database serves continuous application traffic.
scenarios.request: Rewrite sixty million existing rows to compute a new stored value while normal writes continue, keeping lock time and database load bounded throughout rollout.

scenarios.title: Tiny local fixture rewrite does not acquire online-data governance
scenarios.project_brief: A disposable developer fixture database is rebuilt locally for tests.
scenarios.request: Rewrite fifty synthetic fixture rows locally before unit tests.

scenarios.title: Floating production image input composes supply chain
scenarios.project_brief: A service is shipped as a production OCI image and promoted as a release artifact.
scenarios.request: Build the production OCI image from node:latest and publish the resulting artifact as reproducible for the release.

scenarios.title: Pinned local development image does not invent release supply-chain gate
scenarios.project_brief: A local-only development container is used for one developer test command.
scenarios.request: Use a development container image pinned by immutable sha256 digest for a local test command.

scenarios.title: Object-first caller destination still routes server trust
scenarios.project_brief: The application backend can reach public internet and private infrastructure.
scenarios.request: Create a preview service that receives a target URI from the user; the server-side HTTP client requests that destination and returns parsed metadata.

scenarios.title: Browser-only user link does not invent privileged server trust
scenarios.project_brief: A static browser page has no network proxy or server-side fetching capability.
scenarios.request: Display a user-supplied link as a normal browser anchor so clicking it navigates the browser directly.

scenarios.title: Destructive migration in actual diff composes release governance
scenarios.project_brief: A production application uses versioned relational database migrations.
scenarios.request: Update a documentation paragraph only; no data change is planned.

mutations.content:

scenarios.title: Documentation-only actual diff does not acquire migration/release governance
scenarios.project_brief: A production application has a database but this task is documentation only.
scenarios.request: Add a short documentation note about account preferences.

mutations.content: Account preferences are described in this documentation note.
